# Psalm 74 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 74:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Lift-up your-steps to-ruins-of perpetuity; all the-evil the-enemy-has-done in-the-sanctuary.
- **LOGOS:** Direct your steps to the perpetual ruins; the enemy has destroyed everything in the sanctuary.
- **PNEUMA:** Walk through these endless ruins and see — the enemy has demolished everything in your holy place.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 74:4 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Have-roared your-adversaries in-midst-of your-meeting-place; they-have-set their-signs as-signs.
- **LOGOS:** Your foes have roared in the midst of your meeting place; they set up their own signs for signs.
- **PNEUMA:** Your enemies roared like beasts right in the middle of where we used to worship you; they put up their own flags in place of yours.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **PNEUMA:** They set your sanctuary on fire and tore the place where your name lives down to the ground.

## 74:10 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** How-long O-God will-the-adversary taunt? Will-the-enemy spurn your-name to-perpetuity?
